replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Absolutely. With my high neuroticism score, numbers make me nervous. I worry about making mistakes or not understanding concepts quickly. However, I try to manage this anxiety by breaking problems down into smaller steps rather than facing them all at once.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tutor recently. It helped me visualize concepts that confused me. The step-by-step explanations were much clearer than my textbook. It reduced my anxiety because it felt like having a patient tutor available whenever I needed clarification.
